title: Small diffuser but works well
text: Small diffuser but works well. This diffuser is very small and you have to refill several times a day.  Other than that, it is cute, works well.

product_metadata.title: Ominihome Essential Oil Diffuser, 100ML Diffuser for Essential Oils with 7-Color Changing Lights, Mini Aromatherapy Diffuser with Auto Shut Off Function, Portable Cool Mist Humidifier for Home, White
features: Diffuser&Humidifier 2 in 1: Essential Oil Compatible, you can directly add some drops of essential oil into the water tank, the humidifier turns to an oil diffuser, allowing you to enjoy the fragrance and relax your mind immediately.
Charming 7 Color Changing Light: The oil diffuser humidifier can also be used as night lamp or atmosphere lamp.
100ML Water Tank: With 25ml/h mist output and 100ML water tank, this portable essential oil diffuser can run up to 4 hours.
Night light function: You can use this mini humidifier's light function during night in your kid's room as a smooth night light to keep your child safe and sound.
Waterless Auto-Off: the auto shut-off function of the aromatherapy essential oil diffuser gives you peace of mind when using, as the diffuser will be shut-off automatically when water runs out.
